Three details easy get wrong : Serve asset directory , $TMPDIR. Python’s built-http.server ignores Range - answers 200 full body advertises Accept-Ranges - forcing whole file wire every read, ruinous cloud-optimized GeoTIFF. npx servers return 206 Partial Content correctly. Keep R session alive assets live tempdir(). R deletes exit, taking raster leaving stored hrefs pointing nothing. anything beyond walkthrough, use persistent directory. --cors lets browser-based clients STAC Browser read assets; QGIS need , costs nothing. Point asset server: Confirm URL resolves inserting - curl -<href> return 200 OK. production, use blob storage URLs clients fetch assets directly without going API local file server.

title: Serving a STAC API
text: long-running deployment, replace single DBI connection connection pool pool package. concurrency: lone connection held life process eventually closed PostgreSQL connection pooler, every request fails process restarts. pool reconnects instead, hands connections simultaneous requests without contention. Store credentials environment variables rather hardcoding - Posit Connect lets set per-deployment Vars tab.
code: library(pool) library(plumber)  pool <- dbPool(   RPostgres::Postgres(),   host = Sys.getenv("PG_HOST"),   dbname = Sys.getenv("PG_DBNAME"),   user = Sys.getenv("PG_USER"),   password = Sys.getenv("PG_PASSWORD") )  onStop(function() poolClose(pool))  pr <- stac_api_router(   pool,   base_url = Sys.getenv("STAC_BASE_URL") # e.g. "https://connect.example.com/stac" )  pr_run(pr)

title: Create a reusable Azure Blob Storage signing function — azure_signer
text: endpoint Full blob service URL, e.g. "https://myaccount.blob.core.windows.net/". Defaults AZURE_STORAGE_ENDPOINT environment variable. expiry_seconds Lifetime signed URL seconds (default 3600). key_lifetime_seconds long cached user delegation key requested (default 24 hours). Azure caps seven days, must exceed expiry_seconds, otherwise every signature need fresh key cache buy nothing. token Azure AD token AzureAuth::get_managed_token() AzureAuth::get_azure_token(). Defaults NULL, meaning managed identity token obtained key needed — usual choice Azure-hosted infrastructure. service principal auth, obtain token AzureAuth::get_azure_token() pass ; supplied token refreshed goes stale.

title: Create a plumber router serving a minimal STAC API — stac_api_router
text: Search parameters (GET query string POST JSON body): bbox - comma-separated west,south,east,north (GET) array (POST); six-element form west,south,min_elevation,east,north,max_elevation also accepted, box whose west edge exceeds east edge treated crossing antimeridian datetime - ISO 8601 value range start/end; use .. open end collections - collection ID(s) filter ids - item ID(s) filter limit - max results per page (default 10, max 10 000) offset - zero-based page offset (default 0) query - (POST ) property filters form defined STAC API Query extension, covering item property including extension fields "eo:cloud_cover", "sci:doi" "classification:classes". bare value means equality; object selects operators: {"eo:cloud_cover": {"lt": 10}}. Supported operators eq, neq, lt, lte, gt, gte, startsWith, endsWith, contains . properties accepted alias backwards compatibility.
